issue.title: test_skills_inventory_reports_retired_deletion_drift drops full tmp path under xdist
issue.description: The skills inventory renderer at width 160 truncates pytest-xdist tmp paths, so test_skills_inventory_reports_retired_deletion_drift fails when it asserts the full source path is in the table text. Isolated pytest on the same tree passes. Fix by asserting a stable suffix such as /sase_old/SKILL.md rather than str(source), or by not truncating the path in the retired-drift row.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed once under just test-scoped with 4 xdist workers (2703 items) at pytest-1/popen-gw1 tmp paths: assert str(source) in text missed the full chezmoi SKILL.md path. Isolated rerun on the same tree passed in 2.03s (1 passed). Serial-safe. Root cause: Console(width=160) inventory table truncates long xdist tmp paths so the full source path is not in the rendered text. Observed fail rate 1/2 parallel runs, 0/1 serial.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction during finalizer-declaration public-boundary implementation on 2026-08-21. just check lint/symvision passed, then the escalated full scoped suite (4 xdist workers, 2895 items) failed only tests/main/test_skills_handler.py::test_skills_inventory_reports_retired_deletion_drift: assert str(source) in text missed '/var/tmp/sase-d00a07ab/pytest-of-bryan/pytest-17/popen-gw2/test_skills_inventory_reports_0/chezmoi/home/dot_claude/skills/sase_old/SKILL.md' at Console(width=160). Isolated rerun on the same tree passed (1 passed in 1.48s). Serial-safe; current diff touches only src/sase/finalizers/{declaration,commit}.py and tests/test_finalizer_declaration_channel.py.

Proposed by sase-rs.3, sase-rs.4, and sase-rs.6 during epic sase-rs. Current-tree just check at HEAD 28009002d escalated to 10-worker full suite and failed test_skills_inventory_reports_retired_deletion_drift; immediate isolated rerun on the same installed tree passed (1 passed), confirming the existing xdist-only flake. Feature-flag epic files do not own skills inventory rendering.
